summary.name: Baserow
summary.one_liner: Baserow is an open-source no-code platform for building databases, business applications, dashboards and automations, offered as a cloud service or self-hosted.
use_cases: replace spreadsheets with a shared database
building internal business apps without coding
automating workflows with webhooks and HTTP actions
summary.what_it_does: Baserow lets teams organize data in multiple views such as grid, gallery, kanban, calendar, timeline and form. It can import data from CSV, XML and JSON files and connect to external sources. Users can build applications, dashboards and no-code workflows with triggers, branches, conditions and loops, using native HTTP, email and webhook actions plus third-party connectors. The page also describes an API-first design, AI features (AI field, MCP server, AI agents, an assistant called Kuma), and deployment as Baserow Cloud or self-hosted.
notable: Open source under MIT license with self-hosting and unlimited scalability when self-hosted
API-first design where every feature is an API endpoint, plus frontend and backend plugins
Claims GDPR, HIPAA and SOC 2 Type II compliance
Built-in AI features including AI field, MCP server and AI agents
caveats: Free sign-up is offered, but the page does not give specific plan prices or limits
Managed private instance is available only on request
Self-hosted deployment requires running your own infrastructure
